newsitem.title: USA: Apple might change OS strategy - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Apple might change OS strategy - WSJ.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc might announce in the next few months some major changes in strategy for its operating computer system, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted a company spokesman as saying Apple would make "an important strategic announcement" in the next few months about its operating system.
The spokesman did not elaborate, it said, adding that the company had been making vague references to plans to change its strategy in recent weeks.
The newspaper said the company would not say whether it had something to do with its apparent interest to buy Be Inc, which has developed its own operating system.
